long_summary: This document chunk contains detailed biographies of the management team at HealthRate. Tom Sherrard is EVP of Sales & Market Development, with over 17 years of experience in healthcare product, sales, and client management. Tim Michaels is Founder and CEO, with over 30 years of experience in healthcare risk management, analytics, and software development. Each profile includes contact details and focus areas.
